column1: Group 8 CFPB Capstone Data Dictionary: CFPB_CAPSTONE_DB.CFPB_SCHEMA
Source: 02_CFPB_3NF_DDL_Schema in the team GitHub repo. Snowflake records PK, FK and UNIQUE but does not enforce them; only NOT NULL is enforced. Primary key columns are not nullable.

column6: Description
Unique number assigned to each financial company. Generated automatically.
Name of the company the complaint was sent to, trimmed of extra spaces. Each name is stored once.
Unique number for each product and sub-product pair. Generated automatically.
Broad product the complaint is about, e.g. Credit card, Mortgage, Student loan.
More specific product type within the product, e.g. General-purpose credit card. 'N/A' when the CFPB gives no sub-product.
Unique number for each issue and sub-issue pair. Generated automatically.
Main problem the consumer complained about, e.g. Incorrect information on your report.
More specific detail on the issue. 'N/A' when the CFPB gives no sub-issue.
Unique number for each state and ZIP code pair. Generated automatically.
Two-letter state or territory code of the consumer, e.g. NY. 'UNKNOWN' when blank in the source.
Consumer's ZIP code as published by the CFPB. Some are partly masked (e.g. XXXXX). '00000' when blank in the source.
Unique CFPB identifier for each complaint. Rows without a valid numeric ID are rejected on load.
Date the CFPB received the complaint. NULL if the source date could not be read as YYYY-MM-DD.
Date the CFPB forwarded the complaint to the company. NULL if the source date could not be read as YYYY-MM-DD.
Links the complaint to the company it was sent to.
Links the complaint to its product and sub-product.
Links the complaint to its issue and sub-issue.
Links the complaint to the consumer's state and ZIP code.
Channel the complaint came in through, e.g. Web, Phone, Referral. 'Unknown' when blank in the source.
How the company responded, e.g. Closed with explanation, Closed with monetary relief. Set to 'In Progress' when blank in the source.
Whether the company responded within the CFPB's time limit (Yes/No). Set to 'Yes' when blank in the source.
Whether the consumer disputed the company's response. Currently loaded as 'N/A' for all rows (not in the staging table).
Whether the consumer agreed to publish their narrative. Currently loaded as 'N/A' for all rows (not in the staging table).
Unique number for each load batch logged. Generated automatically.
Label identifying the load run.
Number of rows successfully loaded in that batch.
Number of rows rejected in that batch (e.g. invalid complaint ID).
Date and time the batch was loaded. Filled in automatically.
Date the CFPB received the complaint, as text from the CSV.
Product name as text from the CSV.
Sub-product name as text from the CSV.
Issue as text from the CSV.
Sub-issue as text from the CSV.
Company's optional public statement. Not carried into the 3NF tables.
Company name as text from the CSV, before trimming.
Consumer's state as text from the CSV.
Consumer's ZIP code as text from the CSV.
Optional labels such as Older American or Servicemember. Can hold several values in one cell, so not carried into the 3NF tables.
Submission channel as text from the CSV.
Date sent to the company, as text from the CSV.
Company's response as text from the CSV.
Timely response flag as text from the CSV.
Complaint ID as text from the CSV. Cast to a number when loaded into CONSUMER_COMPLAINTS.
